Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

CLAMP, COMPRESSION, MULLER'S 

PATTERN 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for compression clamp, Muller's pattern, used 
in orthopaedic surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 



DETACHABLE HANDLE 
FOR SCREWING- 




€0 



'•^ti©i 









Ail dimensions in miiiimetres. 
FIG. 1 CLAMP, COMPRESSION, MULLER'S PATTERN 

2.1 A deviation of ± 2*5 -percent shall be allowed on all dimensions except on screw threads. 

3. Materia! — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30CM3 or 40CM3 of 15:6603-1972 
1 Specification for stainless steel bars and flats \ 

4. Heat reatment — The compression clamp shall be hardened and tempered to give a 
hardness of 450 to 550 HV.

IS : 9265 - 1979 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The clamp shall be free from cracks, draw marks, pits, burrs and other surface defects. 

5.2 A suitable handle shall be provided for tightening or loosening the clamp screw. The shape 
of a typical handle is shown in Fig. 1. 

5.3 The threads shall be well formed and cleaned and smooth in running. The clamp shall be 
polished bright and passivated. 

5.4 All the edges shall be smooth. 

6. Corrosion Resistance Test — Test the clamp in accordance with IS: 7531-1975 * Method for 
boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments 1 . It 
shall show no sign of corrosion after the test. 

7. Marking — Each compression clamp shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufac- 
turer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
